notes: Google released antigravity-preview-09-2026 on 2026-09-17 in public preview, replacing antigravity-preview-05-2026.
The managed agent uses the Interactions API, plans and reasons, can execute code, manage files in its environment, browse the web, call custom functions, and connect to remote MCP servers.
Only text and image inputs are currently supported; audio, video, and document inputs are unsupported.
Structured output is explicitly unsupported. file_search, computer_use, and google_maps are currently unavailable.
Remote MCP supports Streamable HTTP; SSE transport is unsupported.
Function calling is stateful-only and must continue with previous_interaction_id rather than manually reconstructed stateless history.
For local tool execution or function_call parsing, the September 2026 built-in tool schemas use PascalCase parameters and line-range file replacement.
The filesystem is provided by the environment rather than a standalone filesystem tool.

Google documents automatic context compaction and a configurable max_total_tokens run budget, but does not declare those values as the model context window or max output tokens; CKB therefore leaves those fields unknown.
